additional_info.subject: RE: ID0384579-DC/Si-D/GR-[MP / ND 170000202] SCB offline CRM:00921001201
additional_info.body:
Hello Team,
I trust this email finds you in good health. We have received a technical support request from
n.pantazelos@ppcgroup.com
in your region regarding the following product:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / ND 170000202
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
2lqzjn
Problem Description
: Both outlets unavailable/Offline on SCB
Upon reviewing our asset database, we found that the product is no longer under warranty since 12/07/2023, as a result, we are transferring the case to the regional queue.
Kindly communicate with the customer and provide the necessary service support and/or offer. We have already informed the customer that a regional representative will be in touch shortly.
Should you require further remote or expert support, please order it via PMD. For additional information, please visit the Service Collaboration SharePoint. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Unfortunately, we cannot do much remotely when we don't have SCB connection.
The best would be to have someone on site to check:
The router is connected to internet.
The charger is powered..
And kindly refer the below points which might be the reason to out the charger on SCB.
Then there might be Internet issue with the Siemens router and probably because of failover function the WAN is switched from Cellular to Ethernet.
I would recommend doing a Hard reset from "OCPP" (If charger is connected to OCPP server) or a local reboot will bring them up again.
Data service of mobile network operator might not be available.- SIM card might be disabled / expired (Please check if the SIM card is inserted incorrectly by cleaning and then reinserting it into the XF3 and XF4 router.)- monthly data volume exhausted- signal strength got weak due to changed radio transmission conditions- in case of M2M contracts is IP not enabled
There might be backend related issues.- Backend changed the settings for the affected charger- OCPP server on Backend side unavailable
It could be Teltonika related issues.- Router switches to a wrong network service (e.g. 3G instead of 4G)- Hardware failure of Router- Router software crash
Regards,
Beerpal Singh
eMobility Support
Please do not change the subject line with replying back to this email.
